name: Elise
source: Not much is known about Elise as her meek and quiet nature prevents her from expressing herself. However, that doesn't stop her from trying her best at her job. She has been dutifully assisting Leone ever since she arrived to the tavern and proves to be far more helpful than her appearance suggests.
